# @tscad/plugin-host

[![Homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-default)](https://tscad.vercel.app)

Runs tscad plugins (WebAssembly components) on top of a kernel session, in Bun and browsers

<!-- #endregion header -->

Loads [plugins](../../plugins) (WebAssembly components) and runs them on top of a
`@tscad/kernel` session. Operation plugins are expanded into ordinary tree nodes before the kernel
evaluates a model, so their output is cached like any other subtree.

```ts
import { loadKernel } from '@tscad/kernel';
import { PluginHost, pluginFromDirectory } from '@tscad/plugin-host';

const host = new PluginHost(await loadKernel());
await host.add(await pluginFromDirectory('plugins/grid'));
const tree = await host.lower(model.node); // expands plugin(...) nodes
```

`host.export(tree, '3mf')` runs an exporter plugin, `host.analyze(tree, 'printability')` an
analysis plugin.
